digest.component_or_area: Backend port contract and inbound reconciliation path
propositions: RemoteRef.instance is never populated in production code, only constructed in tests, leaving deployment identity unobservable on the inbound path
Backend port declares no remote_ref() member despite FakeBackend implementing it, creating an asymmetry where tests pass against a fake strictly more capable than production
RemoteRef.instance cannot prevent local-id collision between same-vendor deployments because _jira_key_to_local_id derives ids from Jira key alone, regardless of instance value

instance values must be injected at backend construction from normalized base URLs (context path retained, scheme/case/default port normalized) rather than resolved at call time, to avoid config context dependency in contract tests
Both ADRs 0055 and 0035 must be amended to correct the docstring claim that instance prevents same-vendor collisions and to document that this story does not persist RemoteRef anywhere
